transactions.why: Pineiro missed all 3 practices with an illness and SF said it would sign a practice-squad kicker as insurance. No backup K rostered, so his slot risked a 0 in a matchup projected inside 2 points. Butker was the top FA kicker (7.61) and kicks at 8:20pm, after the 4:25 SF game — so the Pineiro/Butker call can wait until inactives post ~2:55pm. Doubs was the weakest asset: 0.00 on 3 targets in wk1, 10% started, and faces PIT, who allow the fewest fantasy points to WRs.

lineup_changes.why: Projections are effectively tied, so usage decides: Goedert 5 tgt / 77 yds on a winning offense vs Fannin 3 tgt / 21 yds in a 10-34 loss. Market agrees — Fannin's start rate fell 82%->64%, Goedert's rose 48%->60%. NOT because Goedert scored 21.70 last week; that was TD-inflated and will not repeat. Counterpoint held on the record: TB allow the 4th most fantasy points to TEs, TEN only the 12th most, so Fannin has the better matchup and Rotowire still projects Goedert higher despite it.

Lloyd ran 2.8 ypc with no receiving work in wk1 and draws NYJ, who allow the 2nd fewest fantasy points to RBs. Jones beat his wk1 projection, catches passes (half-PPR), and draws CHI, who allow the 7th most.
